purpose: New 2026-10-23 local-only assessment of the frozen translation packet; no quality score is computed by this runner.

runtime.formal_policy: read-only health/models only; never start, stop, reconfigure, or autoload the formal service

judges.vision_policy: N/A_not_supported if runtime props/modalities or matching mmproj does not prove native image support; never OCR fallback

request_contract.text: system frozen judge instructions + one user message containing one English source and one blind candidate translation
request_contract.image: system frozen judge instructions + one user content list containing one instruction text and one image_url data URL; no English transcription or image ground truth
request_contract.pairwise: one fresh AB or BA orientation per call; source/candidate order is packet-frozen
request_contract.response: strict JSON object; invalid/missing is retained and never converted to zero
request_contract.provenance: raw redacted request/response, content/reasoning separated, HTTP/timestamp/request-hash/response-hash/finish/usage/timing, apply-template envelope
